completion_limit: This locks C1 data-hygiene policy thresholds. It is not a near-duplicate scan, not an eval-contamination scan, not a long-run training receipt, and not overall baseline completion.

document_unit.definition: separator-token-delimited document spans in pinned uint16 token shards, separator token id 0

no_recompute_strategy: Reuse exact-dedupe scan receipt for exact duplicate threshold; run near-duplicate and eval-contamination scans only once their inputs and thresholds are locked by this receipt.
scope: single_4090_ge_1b_foundation_ceiling data hygiene controls for the pinned Ember v0 token substrate

eval_contamination.allowed_exception_rule: public benchmark boilerplate or citation text may be allowed only if the receipt records item id, matched span hash, source, and reason; task answer/solution leakage is never allowed
eval_contamination.method_family: exact and normalized n-gram overlap scan from frozen eval prompts/answers/solutions against training corpus documents
eval_contamination.pass_rule: zero unapproved eval items with exact >=32-token overlap or normalized >=200-character solution/prompt span overlap in the training corpus after public-source attribution review

exact_duplicate.metric: exact sha256 over separator-delimited token-byte document span with document length included

near_duplicate_minhash.method_family: MinHash or equivalent token-shingle LSH over separator-delimited documents
near_duplicate_minhash.pass_rule: no near-duplicate pair with estimated or exact token-shingle Jaccard >= 0.80 outside an allowed citation/license/source-family exception list checked into the receipt
near_duplicate_minhash.sample_audit_rule: any LSH candidate that crosses the primary threshold must include deterministic pair ids, source shard names, token lengths, estimated similarity, and exact similarity when feasible
